Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. Objective

Provide cart and checkout functionality for the shopping app.

h3. Context

The app is a shopping app. It needs support for the purchase flow.

h3. Scope

Included:

* Add products to the cart
* Remove products from the cart
* Order products in quantities
* Enter and update shipping details
* Pay using different payment types

Not included:

* N/A

h3. Success criteria

* Users can add products to a cart.
* Users can remove products from a cart.
* Users can set quantities for products in the cart.
* Users can enter shipping details.
* Users can update shipping details.
* Users can pay using different payment types.

h3. Risks and dependencies

* Payment options must support different types of payment.
* Checkout depends on shipping details being available and editable.

h3. Other information

* Issue name: Cart and Checkout

Summary: As a logged-in user, when I am ready to buy, I want to enter all shipping details and then place an order so that I can complete my purchase.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a customer, when I use checkout, I want to log in before continuing so that I can place an order without guest checkout.

As a customer, when I enter shipping details, I want all required fields to be validated so that I can complete checkout correctly.

h3. Context

Checkout requires login. Guest checkout is not allowed.

Shipping details are mandatory.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Login is required for checkout.
* Guest checkout is not available.
* Shipping details must be mandatory.
* Name is required.
* Phone number is required and must be 10 digits.
* Address is required.
* City is required.
* Pin code is required and must be 6 digits.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C5.

Summary: As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want a confirmation page to show a unique Order ID and a confirmation email to be sent so that I know my order was received.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want a confirmation page to show a unique Order ID and a confirmation email to be sent so that I know my order was received.

h3. Context

A customer places an order while logged in. The system should confirm the order on the page and by email.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* When a logged in customer places an order, a confirmation page is shown.
* The confirmation page includes a unique Order ID.
* A confirmation email is sent after the order is placed.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-C6.

Summary: As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want to pay by Card, UPI, or Cash on Delivery so that I can complete my purchase.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a logged in customer, when I place an order, I want to pay by Card, UPI, or Cash on Delivery so that I can complete my purchase.

h3. Context

A logged in customer is placing an order and needs payment options to complete the purchase.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The customer can pay by Card.
* The customer can pay by UPI.
* The customer can pay by Cash on Delivery.
* The customer can complete the purchase after choosing one of these payment methods.

h3. Other information

This comes under requirement REQ-C6.

Summary: As a logged in shopper, I want the cart icon to show the total number of items in the cart so that I can know how many items I have in it.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

* As a logged-in shopper, when I add and remove items from my cart, I want the cart icon to show the total number of items in the cart so that I can quickly see how many items I have.
* As a logged in shopper, when my cart is empty, I want to see a message so that I know there are no items in the cart.

h3. Context

The cart should give a clear visual indication of how many items are in it. It should also show an empty-cart message when there are no items.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The cart icon shows the total number of items in the cart.
* The cart icon updates when items are added.
* The cart icon updates when items are removed.
* When the cart is empty, a message is shown.
* The empty-cart message indicates that there are no items in the cart.

h3. Other information

* This story comes under requirements REQ-C1,REQ-C3.

Summary: As a logged-in shopper, when I have items in my cart, I want to change the quantity of each item from 1 to 10 or remove items from the cart so that the line total is updated correctly.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a logged-in shopper, when I have items in my cart, I want to change the quantity of each item from 1 to 10 or remove items from the cart so that the line total is updated correctly.

h3. Context

Each item in the cart supports a quantity range from 1 to 10.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* Each item in the cart can have a quantity from 1 to 10.
* Changing the quantity updates the line total.
* Removing an item from the cart updates the line total.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C2.

Summary: As a logged in user, when I have a cart value of Rs. 1,000 or more, I want to apply coupon code SAVE10 so that I can get a 10% discount.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a logged in user, when I have a cart value of Rs. 1,000 or more, I want to apply coupon code SAVE10 so that I can get a 10% discount.

h3. Context

Users can apply a coupon during checkout. The coupon code is SAVE10.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The coupon code SAVE10 can be applied by a logged in user.
* The coupon gives a 10% discount.
* The discount applies only when the cart value is Rs. 1,000 or more.
* Only one coupon can be used per order.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-C4.
